meta.description: The MixPad Mirror Smart Bathroom Mirror: makeup-grade light in three color temperatures, automatic defogging, One Step™ voice control, a 4 in screen hidden in the glass and an IPX4 rating.
meta.spec.description: MixPad Mirror specifications: 700 mm round mirror, 28 mm thick, 11 W LED strip, 3000–6000 K, IPX4, 220 V~, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 4.0 and Zigbee.
alt.defog: Fast smart defogging: a mirror that never fogs up
sec3.title: Makeup-grade light that flatters you
sec3.desc: Adjust the brightness as you like and switch freely between three color temperatures for professional makeup lighting.
alt.warm: 3000 K, warm, cozy light: remove makeup at night, set the mood
alt.natural: 4500 K, natural, clear light: helps you get ready, flatters your skin
alt.cool: 6000 K, bright, cool white light: like daylight, it wakes you up
sec3.desc2: * MixPad Mirror's color temperature can be set from 3000 to 6000 K.
sec4.title: Fog gone in seconds, no waiting around
sec4.desc: Automatic defogging, with nothing to switch on. When it detects fog on the mirror, it warms the glass to evaporate it fast, so the mirror always stays clear.
alt.sec4: A finger taps the defog button on a fogged-up mirror, next to an “Auto defog” card
sec4.desc2: * MixPad Mirror's automatic defogging: it tracks the humidity in real time, starts defogging when it rises above 80% RH and stops after an hour.
sec5.title: Hands-free: set the makeup mood by voice
sec5.desc: Even with a hair dryer in hand, you can talk to the mirror to control its light, play music, set alarms and more. Your hands stay free while you enjoy all the convenience of a smart home.
sec5.voice.music: Hi Butler, play some soothing music.
sec5.voice.lightsTimer: Set the lights to 100% and turn them off in 10 minutes.
sec5.voice.weather: Butler, what's the weather like today?
sec5.voice.shower: Hi Butler, please turn on the shower and set it to 20 degrees.
sec5.voice.bath: Turn on bath mode for 30 minutes.
sec5.voice.cleaning: Butler, start cleaning mode and clean the kitchen.
alt.sec5: A woman blow-dries her hair and talks to the mirror: “Butler, play some music.” “Today's weather.”
sec5.desc2: * HomeAI OS gets free updates for life, and more One Step™ features are coming soon.
sec6.title: A caring smart butler, so the weather never catches you out
sec6.desc: Weather, traffic and alarms at a glance: whatever you want to know, it tells you.
alt.sec6_1: Cards on the mirror: the weather (20°), what to wear and a countdown for brushing your teeth
alt.sec6_2: Cards on the mirror: traffic (your route to work is clear), the weather (30°, sunny, Wed, Oct 23) and the news
sec6.mirror_desc: * What-to-wear tips, traffic, news and other features will come in OTA updates.
sec7.row_desc: 35 million high-quality lossless songs, online any time. Waking up, unwinding as you remove your makeup or catching the TikTok top charts, you choose the soundtrack.
alt.music: A woman brushes her teeth at the mirror; below, playlists: Relax, New, Top hits
sec7.row_title2:
Responds in milliseconds:
step up, it lights up
sec7.row_desc2: The high-precision PIR motion sensor turns the light on as you approach, with no touch needed. It responds in milliseconds and spots you the moment you step in front of the mirror.
sec7.row_remind: * MixPad Mirror detects you up to 80 cm in front of the mirror, within 45°; the light fades out 60 s after you leave.
sec7.row_title3:
One seamless mirror,
every detail up close
sec7.row_desc3: An optical coating lets the control screen blend into the glass when it is off, for one seamless surface, and nothing gets in your way as you put on or take off your makeup.
sec8.title: Moisture-proof, every inch of it
sec8.desc: IPX4 water and moisture protection throughout shrugs off splashes and bathroom steam, so the mirror lasts longer.
sec9.title:
A smart bathroom
that works together
sec9.desc: MixPad Mirror now connects with ORVIBO's smart bathroom products*, so the bathroom lights, curtains and heater are yours to control. AI is finding its way into every corner of your life.
sec9.remind: * Connections with more ORVIBO smart bathroom products will follow.
sec10.title: Minimalist design with five-star bathroom style
sec10.desc: The frameless design keeps the lines simple and suits vanity units of any size and style.
spec.name: Product name: MixPad Mirror Smart Bathroom Mirror
spec.button: Mirror button: short press turns the screen off or on; hold for 3 s to restart
spec.color: Color temperature: warm light 3000 K, warm white 4500 K, white light 6000 K
spec.motion: Motion sensing: lights up when you come within 0.8 m of the mirror and fades out 60 s after you leave; voice or manual control too
spec.humidity: Temperature and humidity: voice, manual or automatic; above 80% RH defogging starts by itself, heats for an hour, then stops
spec.defog: Defog module: 350 × 200 mm defog area, ≤ 3.5 W/dm²; power ≤ 13 W at 220 V
spec.cpu: Main chip: RK3326 quad-core Cortex-A7 at 1.5 GHz, 5 W
spec.speaker: Speaker: 1 × 3 W
spec.box: In the box: MixPad Mirror, user manual, certificate of conformity, warranty card
